Zhang, Peng, Huang and Zhou (2002) ecoregion-based jack pine DBH–height models for Ontario

Source: R/hd_zhang2002.R
hd_zhang2002.Rd

Vectorized implementation of the Chapman–Richards height–diameter models of Zhang et al. (2002) for jack pine (PINU.BAN) in Ontario. Predicts total tree height (m) from DBH (cm), by ELC ecoregion, by forest region, or with the province-wide (Overall) fit.

Usage

hd_zhang2002(
  DBH,
  species,
  ecoregion = NULL,
  forest_region = NULL,
  keep_model_id = FALSE
)

Arguments

DBH

Numeric vector. Tree level. Diameter at breast height (1.3 m above ground) outside bark, in cm. Must be >= 0.

species

Character vector. Tree level. NFI species code; only jack pine, "PINU.BAN" (compact "PINUBAN" is accepted), is covered.

ecoregion

Optional character vector. Plot level. Ontario ecoregion code (ELC Working Group 2000): one of "3E", "3S", "3W", "4E", "4S", "4W", "5E" (case and spaces ignored, so "3 e" is accepted). Length 1 or length(DBH). NULL (default) or NA uses the regional or Overall fit.

forest_region

Optional character vector. Plot level. Ontario forest region: "boreal" or "central" (Great Lakes–St. Lawrence; "glsl" and "great lakes-st. lawrence" are also accepted; case-insensitive). Length 1 or length(DBH). Used when ecoregion is NULL/NA; otherwise it must agree with the ecoregion. NULL (default) or NA uses the Overall fit when ecoregion is not supplied.

keep_model_id

Logical. If TRUE, add columns model_id ("zhang2002_ecoregion", "zhang2002_regional" or "zhang2002_overall"), variant ("ecoregion", "regional" or "overall") and parameter_set (the ecoregion code, "boreal", "central" or "overall").

Value

A tibble with column height (m) and, if keep_model_id = TRUE, model_id, variant and parameter_set.

Details

Model form (eq. [1]): $$H = 1.3 + a [1 - \exp(-b \cdot DBH)]^{c},$$ with \(a\), \(b\), \(c\) from Table 2 of the source. Predicted height tends to 1.3 m as DBH tends to 0.

Fit: ordinary nonlinear least squares (SAS PROC NLIN), fitted to 10 727 jack pine trees from Ontario permanent sample plots (trees with forks or damaged tops excluded). The source does not state stand origin.

Parameter sets (selected per row):

  • ecoregion supplied: the ecoregion fit. Ecoregions 3E, 3S, 3W, 4S and 4W (Boreal forest region) and 4E and 5E (Central forest region) are covered (ELC Working Group 2000). Other ecoregion codes are rejected.

  • ecoregion NULL/NA and forest_region supplied: the Boreal or Central regional fit.

  • neither supplied: the Overall fit (all data combined).

If both are supplied, the ecoregion fit is used and forest_region must match the forest region of the ecoregion. One-time messages report the parameter sets in use. The authors found significant differences among ecoregions and recommend the ecoregion models; the regional and Overall fits produced significant prediction bias in individual ecoregions (Tables 4–6 of the source).

Ecoregion boundaries follow the ELC Working Group (2000) map of Ontario ecoregions used by the source; later revisions of the Ontario ecoregion map (e.g. Crins et al. 2009) may differ.

Ecoregion 3S caveat: the authors note an "unusually large" asymptote for ecoregion 3S (\(a = 79.0082\)), attributed to a lack of large trees in the data; predictions beyond its DBH range (2.5–35.3 cm) are unreliable.

Rows with NA DBH or species return NA height. DBH values outside the range of the fitting data of the selected parameter set (Table 1) are computed and reported in a single warning.

No worked example or prediction table is published, so this implementation is validated against the equation and coefficients only (no source benchmark).

References

Zhang, L., Peng, C., Huang, S., and Zhou, X. (2002). Development and evaluation of ecoregion-based jack pine height-diameter models for Ontario. The Forestry Chronicle, 78(4), 530–538. doi:10.5558/tfc78530-4

See also

hd_model_registry(), get_hd_model_info()

Examples

# Ecoregion models
hd_zhang2002(DBH = c(10, 20, 30), species = "PINU.BAN", ecoregion = c("3E", "4W", "5E"))
#> hd_zhang2002(): using the ecoregion models (Table 2).
#> This message is displayed once per session.
#> # A tibble: 3 × 1
#>   height
#>    <dbl>
#> 1   10.1
#> 2   17.4
#> 3   23.0

# Forest-region model when the ecoregion is unknown
hd_zhang2002(DBH = 20, species = "PINU.BAN", forest_region = "central")
#> hd_zhang2002(): `ecoregion` not supplied; using the forest-region
#> (Boreal/Central) models.
#> This message is displayed once per session.
#> # A tibble: 1 × 1
#>   height
#>    <dbl>
#> 1   19.0

# Overall (province-wide) model
hd_zhang2002(DBH = c(10, 20, 30), species = "PINU.BAN", keep_model_id = TRUE)
#> # A tibble: 3 × 4
#>   height model_id          variant parameter_set
#>    <dbl> <chr>             <chr>   <chr>        
#> 1   10.1 zhang2002_overall overall overall      
#> 2   17.8 zhang2002_overall overall overall      
#> 3   21.8 zhang2002_overall overall overall      

# Inside dplyr::mutate()
trees <- data.frame(DBH = c(12, 25, 18), ecoregion = c("3W", "3W", "4S"))
dplyr::mutate(trees, hd_zhang2002(DBH, "PINU.BAN", ecoregion = ecoregion))
#>   DBH ecoregion   height
#> 1  12        3W 12.47433
#> 2  25        3W 20.16552
#> 3  18        4S 15.48519
